name: joint-target-kind
summary: The 検討項目を追加 button is disabled, and says why, whenever resolveJoint reports the target unsupported — in ReviewPane and, after cross-verification, in WorkPackageBoard too. openDraft refuses in the same condition and now takes the finding's own column rather than whatever is selected, so the finding-triggered path cannot get round the button or land on the wrong member. The judgment is the domain function's; neither component adds a member-kind branch of its own.

product.what: ReviewItemsSection resolves the selection through resolveJoint. openDraft returns without opening a draft when the resolved column is not a joint; the add button carries disabled, and an unavailable notice renders the domain's own reason (柱ではない / 円形柱 / 取り付く大梁なし / 部材なし). Added after cross-verification: openDraft takes the column from the finding when one triggered it (onCreateItem passes result.jointRef.columnMemberId) instead of preferring the ambient selection, so a finding about column B cannot create an item about column A.

added after cross-verification: the board built {kind:'joint',columnMemberId:selection.memberId} whenever viewerMode was joint, with no check — the same defect ReviewPane had, on the other entry point. addCurrentTarget now refuses and the 現在の選択を追加 button is disabled with the domain's reason when resolveJoint reports the selection unsupported.

tests.what: three cases (大梁, 円形柱, 取り付く大梁なし柱) assert the button is disabled, the notice names the domain reason, clicking opens nothing and no item is stored; a fourth asserts the resolving column is untouched — button enabled, no notice, the item saved with the joint target and a 未確認 status. A further case selects column A, runs the check on column B's finding and asserts the created item targets B — it fails on the pre-fix code, which targeted A.
a case asserting the 現在の選択を追加 button is disabled and the notice names the domain reason when the joint-mode selection does not resolve, and that no target is stored.

no_new_member_kind_branch: The component never names 柱, 大梁 or 円形 anywhere in this change. It reads resolveJoint's status and, for the message, its reason string. Neutralising resolveJoint therefore neutralises the UI, which is what the falsifiability run below shows.

verification.npm run lint: exit 0 — 2 warnings, both pre-existing on HEAD (verified by stashing this file and re-running)
verification.browser: uc25 20/20, including reviewItemConfirmed — the creation flow on a resolving column is unchanged

falsifiability.mutation: made jointUnavailableReason always null and dropped the resolveJoint guard from openDraft, so an item can be created on any selection again
falsifiability.observed: 3 failed | 20 passed (23) — exactly the three new refusal tests
falsifiability.second_witness: The step 0 reproduction probe, which asserted the pre-fix behaviour, fails after this change with 'Unable to find a label with the text of: タイトル' on all three unresolvable cases — the draft form never opens. The probe was then deleted.

authored_by: Claude Opus 5 (direct implementation at the user's instruction, outside the codex harness)
finding_triggered_path: openDraft is also reached from the findings table's 検討項目にする button, through the request effect. The first version of this fix let that path fall back to the ambient selection, so with the selection moved to another member the item either silently did nothing (unresolvable) or targeted the wrong column (resolvable). The cross-verification ranked the second case first by likelihood. Both are closed by passing the finding's own jointRef.columnMemberId through onCreateItem, and the new ReviewPane test observes it.
